standard.summary: LoKr 同时训练模型中的归一化层可学习参数（如 LayerNorm、GroupNorm）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Has LoKr train the model's learnable normalisation parameters as well (LayerNorm, GroupNorm and so on).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: LoKr 同时训练模型中的归一化层可学习参数（如 LayerNorm/RMSNorm 的缩放/偏置），可增强特征尺度与风格适配；会小幅增加显存占用和 LoRA 文件大小，并增加过拟合风险，普通训练建议先关闭。

advanced_en.principle: Trains the learnable parameters of normalization layers (e.g. LayerNorm/RMSNorm scale/bias) alongside LoKr, which can improve feature-scale and style adaptation; it slightly increases VRAM usage and LoRA file size and raises overfitting risk — keep it off for ordinary training.
